svg.title: bev_fusion_lane_center: the token champion, camera + radar BEV features -> lane-centre graph
svg.text: bev_fusion_lane_center: the token champion, camera + radar BEV features -> lane-centre graph

Token champion (D113 - D120), VAL 873 frames: topo F1 0.6682 / 0.6813 (seeds 0 / 1), 16.2 ms per frame on an RTX 3060, 2.323 M parameters, no TEST check. Orange / red = the named hard steps; everything else is soft.
main path (bold): 13 stages = 5 learned, 2 fixed-differentiable, 2 frozen, 4 rule steps
